profile.summary: mhassan1 is a Senior JavaScript engineer with deep expertise in Axios' HTTP client internals, specializing in URL construction, HTTP adapter consistency, and RFC-compliant networking logic. Their contributions demonstrate advanced debugging skills, particularly in handling edge cases like Data URIs, config propagation, and cross-adapter behavior. The developer shows a strong understanding of JavaScript's object model, regex patterns, and standards compliance, with a focus on maintaining backward compatibility and code quality in a high-impact open-source project.

Replaced non-compliant Data URI regex with RFC 2397-compliant `data-uri-to-buffer` library (PR #4), showing standards awareness
Ensured `config.allowAbsoluteUrls` works across XHR, Fetch, and HTTP adapters (PR #2), proving cross-adapter consistency expertise
Debugged `TypeError` in URL construction edge cases (PR #3), highlighting edge-case handling proficiency
Used `follow-redirects` integration to fix redirect handling in Axios (PR #1), indicating HTTP client architecture knowledge
All PRs resolve specific GitHub issues (#2546, #6806, #6832) with clear problem descriptions, showing strong issue triage skills
Made minimal, focused changes without breaking existing functionality, demonstrating disciplined code quality practices
Replaced custom regex with external library for correctness rather than performance, showing pragmatic dependency management
